source_refs.note: iii. Filtration: a main subheading of 33.6 Wastewater Treatment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 256-256.

blocks.text: Jab zyada tar solids hat jate hain to pani filter kiya jata hai. Yeh mechanical process hai jo baqi fine suspended matter (barik tairte particles) aur kuch microorganisms hatata hai. Aam treatment plant mein pani graded (darja-ba-darja) sand (ret) aur gravel (bajri) ki layers se guzarta hai. Ret physical barrier (rukawat) ka kaam karti hai: particles ret ke daanon ke darmiyan ke pores (chhote soorakhon) mein phans jate hain. Zyada advanced safai ke liye activated carbon use hota hai.
